name: band-alphabet
instructions:
1. Attach a band to a stable object at roughly chest height.
2. Grasp the band with an overlapping grip and assume an athletic position with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart.
3. Press the band horizontally to extension and begin by drawing each letter of the alphabet in a slow, controlled fashion.
4. Once you have completed the desired number of letters, repeat on the opposite side.
